The Vithura foothills offer some of the most scenic trails, but managing slopes and roads requires precision. Our new custom GPX Route Library is built to help you navigate:

🔄 Toggle between clean maps and high-res satellite imagery.
📈 Synced elevation charts calibrated to filter GPS watch noise.
📍 Exact coordinates for loop start points like Anamudi Hostel, Jersey Farm, and the Bonacaud checkpost.

Instagram Caption (Post 3)

Consistency > Speed. ⚡

ASCENT was built on a simple rule: keeping our community moving. That is why our Pulse Leaderboard completely ignores average pace tables.

Instead, we celebrate showing up:
1️⃣ Standing positions are ranked by runs completed per week.
2️⃣ Conquering hills: we track cumulative elevation gains.
3️⃣ Zero pace pressure: walk-joggers and fast runners logging miles side-by-side.

Show up, log your runs, and rise together: run-ascent.github.io/pulse (Link in bio).

The weekly routine that holds us together. We meet every Sunday before the tropical heat rises.
